title: Runtime vocabulary/domain learning and Goblin/Millwood knowledge-barrier fixtures

sections.what: Wire organic runtime acquisition of foreign vocabulary and domain knowledge as character memories (from conversational context, gestures, and reading educational materials/phrasebooks/manuals - not via CraftingSystem.teach) and author verified Goblin/Millwood knowledge-barrier fixtures.
sections.why: Language and domain comprehension barriers are static unless characters can organically learn vocabulary and concepts through lived context, study materials, and memory formation.
sections.how: 1. Keep CraftingSystem.teach scoped to recipes/skills; do NOT add teach lang:<id>:<word> commands.\n2. Treat language and domain knowledge as memory (per task-734): when a character reads educational materials (phrasebooks, manuals, textbooks) via examine/read, or encounters foreign words in clear conversational/gestural context, record semantic/episodic memory entries that unlock understood words/concepts organically.\n3. Author concrete reference fixtures across Millwood (Sammy, Kayla, Zoe) and Goblin/bilingual exchange characters with asymmetrical domain competence, explicit blind spots, and partial vocabulary verified end-to-end by tests.
sections.verify:
1. Verify a character exposed to foreign words in context or study materials forms vocabulary memories and improves comprehension on subsequent turns.
2. Load the Millwood/Goblin knowledge-barrier fixture and confirm Sammy/Kenji comprehension reflects their authored language and domain competence.

acceptance.text: Foreign vocabulary and domain understanding are acquired through memory and lived context (conversational context, object pointing, or reading educational materials/phrasebooks/manuals), NOT via CraftingSystem.teach (which remains dedicated to recipes/skills)
Reading/examining educational materials or experiencing contextual word usage creates semantic/episodic memories that update the character's understood vocabulary and persist across save/load

Millwood character fixtures (Sammy, Kayla, Zoe) and Goblin/bilingual exchange fixtures carry concrete domain competence, explicit ignorant blind spots, and partial known vocabulary verified end-to-end by tests

custom.browser_ui: Inspect character Memories and Mind view after exposure to new vocabulary or study materials; verify comprehension updates without using CraftingSystem.teach.
